items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: I spent some years playing with Davy Tough. ... I was in the early 20s in the Herman band, and Dave was 41 ... By mid-year the brilliant rhythm section of pianist Ralph Burns, bassist Chubby Jackson, guitarist Billy Bauer and drummer Dave Tough was in place.

ctx.x: I think he is absolutely so fantastic. I have a video at home of him with Oscar Peterson. And I met him over in Holland, he was with Oscar, I was with Lionel Hampton’s big band. But I studied the way he plays great time, because I’m a time bass player. I mean that, I think I had the reputation for being a time bass player. And so I studied Niels, then he starts to play a solo and he would breathe between notes. [scats] And all of a sudden it all started to make sense, and of course Oscar Peterson’s backing him…
